featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Pathetic After-Sales Service – Highly Disappointed

Writing this review after 9 months because I wanted to give them enough time before concluding — but unfortunately, my experience has only gotten worse.

Initially, the owner, Mr. Anuj Parikh, was extremely polite and approachable. He gave the impression of someone trustworthy. However, everything changed after delivery.

I faced a major stalling issue throughout the entire monsoon. The root cause? A loose fuel tank lock that allowed water to seep into the tank, leading to constant stalling. It was a nightmare — getting stranded multiple times, away from home, wasting time, energy, and money.

Instead of identifying and fixing the actual issue, Auto World repeatedly charged me for tank cleaning. The real solution was extremely simple — either fixing the lock properly or simply suggesting a basic tank cover. Not once was this advised.

When I escalated the matter to Mr. Anuj, instead of resolving it professionally, he started abusing and using derogatory language. This is absolutely unacceptable behavior from a business owner towards a customer.
There was also a fuel leakage issue that prevented me from filling the tank fully. That too was resolved only after additional expenses from my end.

To make matters worse, I was promised an AMC card with 4 free services. I used one. Now I find out the shop has been handed over to someone else and the AMC card is no longer valid. No accountability. No responsibility.
This is not just poor service — it is complete negligence and lack of business ethics.
I strongly advise everyone to be cautious before dealing with them. Please don’t fall for initial politeness. After-sales support is what truly matters — and here, it is zero.
Would not even rate 1 star if that was an option
